Bin metadata of the Dense slot

Source: R/scmpGenerics.R
cDense.Rd

cDense() returns the bin metadata (colData) of the Dense slot of a ScMaSigPro object, one row per pseudotime bin; cDense<- replaces it.

cDense(object, value = "missing")

cDense(object) <- value

# S4 method for class 'ScMaSigPro'
cDense(object, value = "missing")

# S4 method for class 'ScMaSigPro'
cDense(object) <- value

Arguments

object

A ScMaSigPro object.

value

A data frame of bin metadata, one row per bin.

Value

cDense(object): a data frame with one row per bin. cDense<- and cDense(object, value): the updated object, returned invisibly by the latter.

Details

The bins are the columns of the pseudo-bulk counts. A value with one row per bin replaces the metadata and keeps the counts; its rows may be renamed, and pb_counts() then recomputes the counts. A value with another number of rows, such as bins rebuilt by hand, cannot keep the counts: the Dense slot then holds the metadata without counts, a message says so, and pb_counts() must be run before the next step. cDense(object, value) sets value as cDense(object) <- value does.

See also

Other accessors: cSparse(), eDense(), eSparse(), pathAssign(), predictors()

Examples

data("scmp.ob", package = "scMaSigPro")
bins <- cDense(scmp.ob)
head(bins[, c("Path", "scmp_binned_pseudotime", "scmp_bin_size")])
#>              Path scmp_binned_pseudotime scmp_bin_size
#> Path1_bin_1 Path1                      1            14
#> Path1_bin_2 Path1                      2            15
#> Path1_bin_3 Path1                      3             7
#> Path1_bin_4 Path1                      4            17
#> Path1_bin_5 Path1                      5            13
#> Path1_bin_6 Path1                      6            11

# Add a column to the bin metadata
bins$early <- bins$scmp_binned_pseudotime <= 4
cDense(scmp.ob) <- bins
